title: Lambdas as strategies
description:
Pass behaviour around with functional interfaces.

```
apply(5, double) = 10
apply(5, square) = 25
compose double then square: 100
names longer than 3: [Grace, Alan]
```
hints: `List<String> result = new ArrayList<>(); for (String n : names) if (longer.test(n)) result.add(n);`, or wait for streams in the next lesson.
requirements: Filter a list with a `Predicate<String>` written as a lambda, and print with a method reference (`System.out::println`).
stretch: Write your own functional interface `@FunctionalInterface interface Validator<T>` with a default method `and`.
